name: U-Shaped Toothbrush For Kids / Toddler - Toothbrush with Food Grade Soft Silicone Brush Head - Manual Whole Mouth Toothbrush for Kids Age 6-12 Year - 360° Oral Teeth Cleaning Design
description:
Product details of U-Shaped Toothbrush for Kids (Age 6–12 Years) – 360° Oral Cleaning Design

Product Type: Kids / Toddler Manual Toothbrush

Design: U-Shaped, Whole Mouth Cleaning

Material: Food-grade soft silicone brush head & durable plastic handle

Size: Approx. 4.72 in. (12cm)

Suitable Age: 6–12 years

Origin: Made in China

Key Features:

360° cleaning design – U-shaped brush head covers teeth & gums in all directions for deep, effective cleaning

Soft silicone bristles – Gentle on children’s tender and sensitive teeth

Durable handle – Made of high-quality plastic, lightweight, easy to grip, and comfortable for kids’ small hands

Fun & easy to use – Apply toothpaste, place in mouth, and shake gently for quick, full-mouth cleaning

Works best with foam toothpaste for enhanced results

Encourages kids to enjoy brushing, making dental care simple and effective
